tables.name: edgeNodeValues
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `edgeNodeValues` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'ID',
  `clusterId` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '集群ID',
  `nodeId` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '节点ID',
  `role` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '节点角色',
  `item` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '监控项',
  `value` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '数据',
  `createdAt` bigint(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '创建时间',
  `day` varchar(8) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '日期',
  `hour` varchar(10) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '小时',
  `minute` varchar(12) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '分钟',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `nodeId_role_time` (`nodeId`,`role`,`item`,`day`,`hour`,`minute`) USING BTREE,
  KEY `nodeId` (`nodeId`),
  KEY `clusterId` (`clusterId`),
  KEY `role_item_minute` (`role`,`item`,`minute`),
  KEY `day` (`day`),
  KEY `hour` (`hour`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='节点监控数据'

tables.name: edgeNodes
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `edgeNodes` (
  `id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'ID',
  `adminId` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '管理员ID',
  `userId` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '用户ID',
  `level` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '级别',
  `lnAddrs` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Ln级别访问地址',
  `isOn` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '是否启用',
  `isUp` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '是否在线',
  `countUp` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '连续在线次数',
  `countDown` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '连续下线次数',
  `isActive` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '是否活跃',
  `inactiveNotifiedAt` bigint(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '离线通知时间',
  `uniqueId` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '节点ID',
  `secret` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '密钥',
  `name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '节点名',
  `code` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '代号',
  `clusterId` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '主集群ID',
  `secondaryClusterIds` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '从集群ID',
  `regionId` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '区域ID',
  `groupId` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '分组ID',
  `createdAt` bigint(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '创建时间',
  `status` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '最新的状态',
  `version` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '当前版本号',
  `latestVersion` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '最后版本号',
  `installDir` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '安装目录',
  `isInstalled` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '是否已安装',
  `installStatus` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '安装状态',
  `state` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '状态',
  `connectedAPINodes` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '当前连接的API节点',
  `maxCPU` int(4) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '可以使用的最多CPU',
  `maxThreads` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '最大线程数',
  `ddosProtection` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'DDOS配置',
  `dnsRoutes` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'DNS线路设置',
  `maxCacheDiskCapacity` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '硬盘缓存容量',
  `maxCacheMemoryCapacity` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '内存缓存容量',
  `cacheDiskDir` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '主缓存目录',
  `cacheDiskSubDirs` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '其他缓存目录',
  `dnsResolver` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'DNS解析器',
  `enableIPLists` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '启用IP名单',
  `apiNodeAddrs` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'API节点地址',
  `offlineDay` varchar(8) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '下线日期YYYYMMDD',
  `offlineIsNotified` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '下线是否已通知',
  `isBackupForCluster` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '是否为集群备用节点',
  `isBackupForGroup` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '是否为分组备用节点',
  `backupIPs` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备用IP',
  `actionStatus` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '当前动作配置',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `uniqueId` (`uniqueId`),
  KEY `clusterId` (`clusterId`),
  KEY `groupId` (`groupId`),
  KEY `regionId` (`regionId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='节点'

tables.name: edgePlans
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `edgePlans` (
  `id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'ID',
  `isOn` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '是否启用',
  `name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '套餐名',
  `description` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '套餐简介',
  `clusterId` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '集群ID',
  `trafficLimit` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '流量限制',
  `bandwidthLimitPerNode` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '单节点带宽限制',
  `features` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '允许的功能',
  `hasFullFeatures` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '是否有完整的功能',
  `trafficPrice` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '流量价格设定',
  `bandwidthPrice` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '带宽价格',
  `monthlyPrice` decimal(12,2) unsigned DEFAULT '0.00' COMMENT '月付',
  `seasonallyPrice` decimal(12,2) unsigned DEFAULT '0.00' COMMENT '季付',
  `yearlyPrice` decimal(12,2) unsigned DEFAULT '0.00' COMMENT '年付',
  `priceType` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '价格类型',
  `order` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '排序',
  `state` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '状态',
  `totalServers` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '可以绑定的网站数量',
  `totalServerNamesPerServer` int(255) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '每个网站可以绑定的域名数量',
  `totalServerNames` int(255) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '总域名数量',
  `monthlyRequests` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '每月访问量额度',
  `dailyRequests` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '每日访问量额度',
  `dailyWebsocketConnections` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '每日Websocket连接数',
  `monthlyWebsocketConnections` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '每月Websocket连接数',
  `maxUploadSize` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '最大上传',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `state` (`state`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='用户套餐'

tables.name: edgeReportResults
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `edgeReportResults` (
  `id` bigint(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'ID',
  `type` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '对象类型',
  `targetId` bigint(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '对象ID',
  `targetDesc` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '对象描述',
  `updatedAt` bigint(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '更新时间',
  `reportNodeId` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '监控节点ID',
  `isOk` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '是否可连接',
  `level` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '级别',
  `costMs` decimal(11,2) DEFAULT '0.00' COMMENT '单次连接花费的时间',
  `error` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '产生的错误信息',
  `countUp` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '连续上线次数',
  `countDown` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '连续下线次数',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uniqueId` (`reportNodeId`,`type`,`targetId`) USING BTREE,
  KEY `target` (`type`,`targetId`),
  KEY `reportNodeId` (`reportNodeId`)

  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE,
  UNIQUE KEY `uniqueId` (`billId`,`regionId`) USING BTREE,

tables.name: edgeUsers
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `edgeUsers` (
  `id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'ID',
  `isOn` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '是否启用',
  `username` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '用户名',
  `password` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '密码',
  `fullname` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '真实姓名',
  `mobile` varchar(11) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '手机号',
  `verifiedMobile` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '已验证手机号',
  `mobileIsVerified` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '手机号是否已验证',
  `tel` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '联系电话',
  `remark` varchar(1024) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备注',
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '邮箱地址',
  `verifiedEmail` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '激活后的邮箱',
  `emailIsVerified` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '邮箱是否已验证',
  `avatarFileId` bigint(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '头像文件ID',
  `createdAt` bigint(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '创建时间',
  `day` varchar(8) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'YYYYMMDD',
  `updatedAt` bigint(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '修改时间',
  `state` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '状态',
  `source` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源',
  `clusterId` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '集群ID',
  `features` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '允许操作的特征',
  `registeredIP` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '注册使用的IP',
  `isRejected` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '是否已拒绝',
  `rejectReason` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '拒绝理由',
  `isVerified` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '是否验证通过',
  `requirePlans` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '是否需要购买套餐',
  `modules` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '用户模块',
  `priceType` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '计费类型：traffic|bandwidth',
  `pricePeriod` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '结算周期',
  `serversEnabled` tinyint(1) unsigned DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '是否禁用所有服务',
  `notification` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '通知设置',
  `bandwidthAlgo` varchar(16) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '带宽算法',
  `bandwidthModifier` decimal(4,0) unsigned DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '带宽修正值',
  `lang` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '语言代号',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `username_state` (`username`,`state`),
  KEY `username` (`username`),
  KEY `day` (`day`),
  KEY `verifiedEmail` (`verifiedEmail`),
  KEY `verifiedMobile` (`verifiedMobile`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='用户'
